Source: Overall, the pooled prevalence of the use of herbal medicine among patients with cancer was 22% (95% confidence interval (CI): 18%–25%), with the highest prevalence estimates for Africa (40%, 95% CI: 23%–58%) and Asia (28%, 95% CI: 21%–35%).
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, omuwendo ogw’awamu ogw’abalwadde ba kookolo abakozesa eddagala ly’ekinnansi gwali ku bitundu 22% (obukakafu (CI) bwa bitundu 95%: 18%–25%), ng’omuwendo omuteebereze ogw’abantu abasing okukozesa eddagala ly’ekinnansi guli mu Afirika (40%, 95% CI: 23%–58%) ne Asia (28%, 95% CI: 21%–35%).
Yoruba: Lápapọ̀, àṣàjọ ìwọ́pọ̀ ìlò oògùn ajẹmégbògi láàrin àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní jẹjẹrẹ jẹ́ 22% (ọ̀gangan ìfọwọ́sọ̀yà 95% (CI): 18%–25%), pẹ̀lú gbèdéke ìṣìrò ìwọ́pọ̀ fún Áfíríkà (40%, 95% CI: 23%–58%) àti Éṣíà (28%, 95% CI: 21%–35%).
Zulu: Ngokuphelele, ukusabalala okuhlanganisiwe kokusetshenziswa kwemithi yamakhambi phakathi kweziguli ezino mdlavuza kwaba ama-22% (95% confidence interval (CI): 18%-25%), ngesilinganiso esiphezulu sokuvama kwe-Afrika (40%, 95% CI: 23%-58%) ne-Asia (28%, 95% CI: 21%-35%).
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, yawan amfani da magungunan ganye a tsakanin marasa lafiya da ciwon daji shi ne kashi 22% (95% tazarar tabbaci (CI): 18%–25%), tare da ƙiyasin yawaitar mafi girma ga Afirka (40%, 95% CI: 23%–58%) da kuma Asiya (28%, 95% CI: 21%–35%).
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, go tlala fao go kgethilwego mabapi le tšhomišo ya dihlare tša mešunkwane gareng ga balwetši ba kankere e bile 22% (95% ya sebaka sa boitshepo (CI): 18%–25%), with the highest prevalence estimates for Africa (40%, 95% CI: 23%–58%) and Asia (28%, 95% CI: 21%–35%).
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ በካንሰር ህመምተኞች መካከል ያለው የእጽዋት መድሃኒቶች አጠቃቀም የመስፋፋት ስብስብ 22% (95% አስተማማኝ ክፍተት (አ.ክ)፤ 18%–25%)  ለአፍሪካ ከፍተኛዎቹ  የመስፋፋት ግምቶች (40%, 95% አ.ክ፤ 23%–58%) እና ለእስያ (28%, 95% አ.ክ: 21%–35%) ነበሩ፡፡
